scenarios.description: Pause queue consumers and introduce backlog to validate lag handling and catch-up.
successCriteria: queue backlog drains below threshold within 900 seconds
latency budget breach alert is emitted

scenarios.description: Trigger managed database failover and validate application recovery path.
successCriteria: write path recovers with no durable data loss
read path degrades gracefully during failover
service returns to healthy state within RTO

scenarios.description: Disable external provider integration (maps/notification/payment mock) and validate fallback behavior.
successCriteria: requests are queued or degraded without hard failure
